items.question: How does VClaw actually make me work more effectively?
items.answer: VClaw takes over the most time-consuming parts of your day. For commerce, it auto-extracts product info, suggests replies, and monitors payments/shipping. For recruitment, it parses CVs, scores job suitability, and fetches LinkedIn data. All in one interface.

items.question: Does VClaw keep candidate and customer data private?
items.answer: Data privacy is our top priority. All chat logs, orders, CV uploads, and LinkedIn profiles are stored and processed locally on your Mac. VClaw never uploads your business data to external cloud servers.

items.question: Is VClaw really free?
items.answer: Yes, completely free. No account signup, no credit card required. Just download the pkg, install in 2 minutes, and start immediately.

items.question: Can I connect different AI models?
items.answer: Yes. You can easily connect VClaw to DeepSeek, OpenAI GPT-4, Google Gemini APIs, or run offline models (like Llama or Mistral via Ollama) completely offline on your Mac.

items.question: Which operating systems does VClaw support?
items.answer: VClaw is available for both Windows 10/11 (x64) and macOS — including Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4) and older Intel Macs. Just grab the installer that matches your platform from the Download section.
